title: Plugins change the map through one helper: walkway, solid, oncePerWorld
body:
Last item from the code review (item 8). Five plugins change map tiles when they start: the rowboat's dock, the forest maze, Luna Park, the garden and the boxing ring. Each wrote `world.tiles` by hand, with two copies of a once-per-map guard and edge checks in only one place. Luna Park also added its street name again on React's dev double start: `world.names` had "Luna Park" twice.

Now they all use `src/city/world/edit.ts` (tested):
- `walkway(world, name, cells)`: walkable ground under a street sign. The name is added once, so running it again reuses it.
- `solid(world, cells, { only })`: ground nobody walks through, optionally only over one kind of tile (the garden only clears park).
- `cellsIn(x, y, w, h)` and `oncePerWorld(world, key, make)`. The second replaces the rowboat's and the maze's own WeakMaps.
- All of them skip cells off the map.

`createIsland` now notes where plugin order matters: the garden comes before the squirrels, and the rowboat before the mermaids. `src/city/CLAUDE.md` tells new plugins to use the helper and never write `world.tiles` by hand.

**The map comes out identical.** I fingerprinted the finished map in a dev build on this branch and on `main`, and both have the same tile hash and the same street name on every tile (711748511). The only difference is 304 names instead of 305: no duplicate "Luna Park".

489 tests pass, and the build and smoke test pass.

## Story

Idea: One way for a character to change the map.
Where: none
Tags: code, map
Asked vs made: Asked to look closer at review item 8 and then build the helper. Made it, moved all five plugins onto it, and fixed Luna Park's duplicate street name.
